locator.name: keeps the in-flight frame open on cold timeout without reloading, and accepts a late ready

proves.facet: Verifies cold timeout keeps generation 1 open with kept-open problem copy, rejects wrong-origin/wrong-source ready messages, and clears stale problem to open WORKER on a late trusted ready.

1.note: The recovery fixtures anchor post-load readiness to onLoad, require unanswered request ping before URL fallback, keep waiting notice with Retry when unconfirmed, and preserve explicit Retry.

2.note: The no-second-load case pins that cold readiness timeout keeps generation 1 open and Retry reloads once.

3.note:
The workspace cases move by message without reload.

Anchor: "it('moves across workspaces by message, without reloading the frame'"

4.note:
Opt-in hidden preload reads the descriptor once, names no agent in the initial URL and activates by message in the same frame generation.

Anchor: "it('preloads a hidden pane without loading an agent, and shows the agent by message (MIK-R89 v2 rule 12)'"

5.note: Cold-load cap settles without reloading while rejecting wrong-origin/wrong-source messages and accepting a late trusted ready.
